integrity: All-dimensional proof is analytical; finite linear-programming checks are corroboration, not exhaustive proof. The independent mathematical review is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: The formula is for real-linear operators extending scalar Lipschitz functions from regular Euclidean simplex vertices to the full finite set of edge midpoints; no arbitrary-simplex, complex-scalar, or whole-simplex extension theorem is asserted. Unindexed equivalent prior literature cannot be completely excluded.
title: Sharp linear Lipschitz extension to the edge midpoints of a regular simplex
